problem_register_binding.source: Post-switch viewer crawl: the BFF answers a viewer's approvals read with a typed 403 (FORBIDDEN, details.permission_state=no_permission, surface=approvals); approvals, governance and the rebalance/deployment/evolution/capital-pool detail pages treated it as a data failure.

typed_no_permission_contract.definition: HTTP 403 whose error envelope ({error:{...}} or {detail:{error:{...}}}) has a string code and details.permission_state === "no_permission"; details.surface is carried when present.
typed_no_permission_contract.fe_helper: src/lib/bff-v1/permissionState.ts (isNoPermissionError, noPermissionSurface, sectionReadFailure). Not added to the bff-v1 public barrel (fullOperationAssembly allowlist unchanged).
typed_no_permission_contract.fe_marker: Rendered no-permission elements carry data-permission-state="no_permission" and data-permission-surface=<surface>: NoPermissionState (section card) and NoPermissionBadge (tab trigger, so the state is visible while the tab is not selected). src/platform/components/NoPermissionState.tsx.
typed_no_permission_contract.not_no_permission: An untyped 403, a 401, a 5xx and a network error render SectionReadError (role=alert, 'Failed to load this section.' / '無法載入此區塊。') or, on /management/governance/:id, the existing 'Approval request unavailable' state.

pages./management/approvals: ApprovalsPage: pending-list error -> sectionReadFallback (typed 403 -> NoPermissionState; otherwise SectionReadError, where it previously showed an empty table). 'All' tab decisions read: typed 403 -> NoPermissionState, otherwise the existing decisions error card.
pages./management/governance: GovernanceQueuePage: reload records a SectionReadState; typed 403 -> NoPermissionState, otherwise SectionReadError (previously an unhandled rejection + empty table). Batch readback still sees the rejection.
pages./management/governance/:id: GovernanceReview: typed 403 on approvals.get -> header + NoPermissionState; untyped 403/401/5xx -> existing 'Approval request unavailable'; 404 -> existing not-found.
pages.rebalance/deployment/evolution detail: Approvals read now gated on a loaded entity (const loadedId = entity ? id : undefined), so a not-found id issues no approvals read. Typed 403 -> NoPermissionBadge on the approvals tab + NoPermissionState in the tab; other failures -> SectionReadError. The rest of the page (header, other tabs, reads) is unchanged.
pages.capital-pool detail: Governance tab: typed 403 -> badge + NoPermissionState; other failures -> SectionReadError (previously swallowed to an empty table). Rebalances/audit reads unchanged.

AC1_pages_render_no_permission.tests: src/management/pages/approvalsNoPermission.test.tsx (39 tests): per detail page typed 403 -> badge + section with surface=approvals while the entity renders; untyped 403 / 401 / 5xx / network error -> SectionReadError and no marker; exactly one approvals read; not-found id -> no approvals read; governance queue, governance review and approvals page (approvals page through the real client fetch -> BffError parse) typed vs untyped/401/5xx.

AC2_crawl_honest_no_permission.rule: typedNoPermission(status, body) recognises the typed 403 body (body inspected only for 403 responses and existing route data reads; nothing is stored beyond {surface}). The snapshot collects visible [data-permission-state=no_permission] markers (getClientRects().length > 0) with their surface. honestNoPermission excuses a 403 only when it is typed AND a rendered marker matches its surface (or any marker when the body names no surface). Excused in apiFailure, counted as a valid read, and recorded in failedReads with honestNoPermission=true, counted=false. Mirrors honest-not-found (404 AND rendered not-found text).
AC2_crawl_honest_no_permission.still_fails: untyped 403 (even with the marker rendered), typed 403 without the rendered state, typed 403 whose surface differs from the rendered one, 401, 5xx with a no-permission-shaped body.
AC2_crawl_honest_no_permission.mutation_check: Removing the honestNoPermission exclusion from apiFailure makes exactly the two 'passes' crawl tests fail (verified, then restored).

AC3_tests.crawl: src/test/accept-management-honest-not-found.test.ts: 39/39 (10 new in 'honest no-permission rule (typed 403 + rendered state)'; the existing 'viewer-only GET /bff/approvals 403 still fails' cases keep passing with an untyped body; the source assertion now checks the loaded-entity gate).
AC3_tests.full_suite: vitest run (all 293 files): 3651 passed, 1 failed (fullOperationAssembly public-export allowlist, caused by a barrel export of permissionState); export removed, the file then passed 16/16 together with the new component tests. typecheck (tsc -p tsconfig.app.json) exit 0; eslint on touched files 0 errors.

AC4_runtime_budget.requests: No extra request per page. Each listed page still issues one approvals read when the entity is loaded; rebalance/deployment/evolution detail pages now issue zero approvals reads for a not-found id (one fewer). The crawl issues no new requests; it reads the JSON body of 403 responses it already observes.

AC5_evidence_and_hosted.hosted_acceptance: Pending: requires the next Dev release crawl (viewer) after merge to show these routes no longer listed for a 403. No hosted crawl was run from this worker (no viewer token here).
AC5_evidence_and_hosted.reviewer_family: Owner Claude (Anthropic); reviewer Antigravity (different model family).

residual_findings: StrategyDetail (out of the listed scope) reads approvals only on demand when its governance section opens (GOVERNANCE_SECTIONS), so the crawl does not issue that read; when opened as viewer it shows its generic 'unavailable' section state rather than NoPermissionState. Follow-up candidate.
Other approvals readers outside the listed scope (Operations runtimes/other tabs, v5 LoopRunDrawer, NotificationCenter) were not changed.
